issue.title: sase plan propose handoff never commits the proposer's dirty edits, so successor-rule landers lose plan status and landing fixes
issue.description:
Found by the bob-cli-dw land agent (epic bob-cli-dw, Backlog batch B6) while preparing the successor-rule plan proposal.

Every lander in the backlog-batch successor chain (plans 202610/backlog_batch_a1, b2, b3, b4, b5) followed the land prompt: set the epic plan's frontmatter `status: done` in the plans sidecar, then ran `sase plan propose` as its final action, per each plan's "Landing and successor rule". All five epics (bob-cli-d7, -da, -dd, -df, -dp) are CLOSED, but all five plan files stayed `status: wip` on plans origin/main until the bob-cli-dw lander fixed them by hand. Earlier batches (backlog_batch2 through 18) ended with an ordinary final declaration, and all are `status: done`. The bob-cli-dp.land--mon transcript shows the approval launch archiving and linking only backlog_batch_b6.md in the proposer's plans sidecar ("Archived ... (committed)"). No commit carries the b5 status edit.

Likely root cause: a successful `sase plan propose` hands off by SIGTERM and is exempt from `/sase_final`. No final declaration is submitted, so the host's builtin@commit finalizer never runs for the proposing turn. The approved epic then launches phase agents in other workspaces. Any uncommitted edits the proposer made in its primary checkout, sidecars, or repos opened with `sase repo open` are stranded in the ephemeral workspace. This includes plan-status updates, and also code fixes a lander makes in the same turn.

Impact: the land prompt requires plan-status updates and allows landing fixes in the same turn as the successor proposal, so every chained lander silently loses that work. The bob-cli-dw lander ended its turn with a declaration instead of proposing B7, so its sase test fix and plan edits are committed. That leaves the backlog chain paused.

Expected: either `sase plan propose` runs host completion (commit decisions for every dirty owned or opened repo) before handing off, or it refuses to propose while owned repositories are dirty and names them. Related: bob-cli-dn fixed opened-repo obligation inheritance for monitor continuations, not plan handoffs. Verify by reproducing in a scratch project: dirty a sidecar file, propose a plan, approve it, then confirm the edit was committed (or the proposal was refused).

task_type_fields.repro: In a lander turn, edit a plans-sidecar file (e.g. set an epic plan status: done) and leave it uncommitted, then run sase plan propose on a validated epic and approve it; the edit never reaches plans origin. Observed for 202610/backlog_batch_a1, b2, b3, b4, b5 (epics d7, da, dd, df, dp all closed; plans stayed status: wip).

issue.creation_reason: Five consecutive backlog-batch landers lost their plan 'status: done' edits because their final action was a plan-propose handoff, which submits no final declaration; any landing fix made in the same turn would be lost the same way.

payload.entry: bob-cli CORROBORATING LOSS INVENTORY (sase-1ph.land, 2026-10-28). Epic sase-1ph swept every run since 2026-10-14 that ended in an epic-plan handoff. Turns that lost uncommitted edits by ending with sase plan propose: (a) five bob-cli backlog landers (d7, da, dd, df, dp) lost epic plan status: done, recovered by bob-cli-dw.land in plans 98fc47f; (b) bob-cli-df.land--code lost the sase _RecoveryAssessment -> RecoveryAssessment rename, recovered by sase 196690f6cb (bob-cli-dw.1); (c) sase-1ou.land lost the sase-core connection.rs + tests/contention.rs fix, restored as sase-core df14e8f4, and sase-1p6 had been closed citing it; (d) sase-1ou.land lost the sase tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt reconciliation, restored as sase df0070b0aa; (e) bob-cli-dp.land--code lost the sase _link_files.py/validate_committed_plans.py nested plan-root change and its test, re-implemented as sase 60a4fe8a92, and bob-cli-dg had been closed citing it; (f) bob-cli-d7.land--code lost bob-cli src/native/highlights_ref/create.rs, restored as bob-cli 4005c613, and bob-cli-d7 had been closed citing it; (g) bob-cli-dd.land--code lost bob-cli pomodoro_themes/rename.rs + tests/cli/themes_rename.rs, ported as bob-cli 687375eb (split fixed too), and bob-cli-dc had been closed citing it. Four closeout tale plans were also left wip (d7_heading_prefix_closeout, backlog_b3_rename_closeout, finish_backlog_b4, b5_validation_closeout); they are now done. Older chain landers (10-24 to 10-26) had their edits committed by successors. Every loss followed the same pattern: the proposing turn's commit finalizer never ran (finalizer phase stayed 'planned'), and the workspace was later reset. sase-1ph changed only recovery, not the handoff mechanism, so this task stays open for the prevention fix. -P
